knowledge:
- key_parameters: method="density" (specifies density estimation followed by numerical integration in KLD.matrix) ;; supp=range(exData) (defines the support range for numerical integration in KLD.matrix) ;; sample=FALSE (determines whether to compute distances between genes/rows [FALSE] or samples/columns [TRUE] in tau.dist and spearman.dist)
- alternatives: Standard R dist function (for basic distance metrics like Euclidean, Manhattan, etc., whereas bioDist provides advanced biological distance measures like MI and KLD).
- when_to_use: Appropriate when analyzing high-dimensional biological data (e.g., gene expression) where non-linear associations (Mutual Information) or distributional shape differences (Kullback-Leibler Divergence) are more informative than standard Euclidean distances.
- pitfalls: Mutual information calculations (MIdist and mutualInfo) are computationally intensive and can be very slow on large datasets.

workflows.name: mutual_information_and_kl_divergence_distance
workflows.intent: Calculate mutual information and Kullback-Leibler divergence distances between samples in an expression dataset.
input: expression_matrix.csv (a matrix of gene expression values with genes as rows and samples as columns)
workflows.stages: 1. Transpose the expression matrix to compute distances between samples. 2. Compute mutual information distance using MIdist or distance from independence using mutualInfo. 3. Compute Kullback-Leibler divergence using binning (KLdist.matrix) or density estimation (KLD.matrix).
workflows.code:
library("bioDist")
data(sample.ExpressionSet)
exData = t(exprs(sample.ExpressionSet))
s1 = MIdist(exData)
s2 = as.matrix(s1)
dim(s2)
r1 = mutualInfo(exData)
kl1 = KLdist.matrix(exData)
kl2 = KLD.matrix(exData, method="density", supp=range(exData))

workflows.name: correlation_distance_and_neighbor_search
workflows.intent: Calculate correlation-based distances (Spearman's rho and Kendall's tau) between genes and find the nearest neighbors for a specific gene.
input: expression_set.RData (an ExpressionSet object containing gene expression data)
workflows.stages: 1. Subset the ExpressionSet to the genes of interest. 2. Compute Kendall's tau distance between genes using tau.dist with sample=FALSE. 3. Compute Spearman's rho distance between genes using spearman.dist with sample=FALSE. 4. Find the top nearest neighbor genes for a query gene using closest.top.
workflows.code:
eS = sample.ExpressionSet[401:500,]
tauD = tau.dist(eS, sample=FALSE)
sp = spearman.dist(eS, sample=FALSE)
f1 = featureNames(eS)[1]
closest.top(f1, sp, 3)
